description: This is the main source file for the EPON Agent SSP component, responsible for initialization, signal handling, daemonization, and command dispatching within the EPON agent framework.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Handles different commands such as connecting to bus daemon, retrieving parameters, printing memory tables, and canceling SSP based on input character.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current call stack for debugging purposes.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon by forking, creating a new session, and redirecting standard file descriptors to /dev/null.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles various signals, performs cleanup, and prints stack trace on unexpected signals.

methods.name: is_core_dump_opened
methods.description: Checks if core dump is enabled for the process.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program; initializes configuration, sets up signal handlers, daemonizes if needed, and runs the main loop.
